note: Cell geometry is measured from the model at load time; the numbers recorded here are what that measurement produced when the collection was added, so a changed model is visible as a mismatch rather than silently believed.
fit_caveat: The source collection records that the current flight meshes are wider and taller than these cells (Harpy 2.10 m span against a 1.54 m cell). The airframe is hidden while sealed, which is what the launch presentation already does, so the round is not drawn inside a cell it does not fit.
